headline: A Decade of Excellence in Digital Marketing Education
tagline: Empowering Digital Learning · Shaping Future Marketers · Excellence, Innovation, Integrity

decade_of_excellence.summary: Established in 2014, DIDM has been a pioneer in digital marketing education, shaping the careers of over 70,000+ Success stories in India. Over the past decade, we have set industry benchmarks with our expert-led training, hands-on projects, and globally recognized certifications. Our legacy is built on innovation, excellence, and an unwavering commitment to empowering individuals with future-ready digital skills. From classroom training to AI-driven marketing strategies, DIDM continues to evolve, ensuring our students stay ahead in the ever-changing digital landscape.
decade_of_excellence.callout: Join us in celebrating 10 years of success, impact, and transformation!

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: In this era of digitization, Digital Marketing is practised by every company. At DIDM, we commit to provide quality training in advanced digital marketing courses and in-depth knowledge of digital marketing strategies to meet the growing demands of skilled individuals across the world. Our objective is to utilize our Digital Marketing Course not only to provide knowledge in existing internet marketing concepts but also to come up with new strategies in a way companies make their existence in the market to stay competitive.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: The vision of the Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing is to teach and train our students to become successful digital marketers and contribute to the welfare of the entire society. Digital marketing is the most widely used marketing aid, also a reason which makes it more demanding. We, at DIDM, nurture individuals with qualifying training and skills. Our motive behind starting and expanding DIDM is to develop skilled professionals across PAN India.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: Our digital marketing course will help you achieve every goal. It comes along with 50+ modules. You can choose according to your area of interest. Also, we provide 100% placement Assistance like no other digital marketing institute as we have 650+ company tie-ups in IT and Non-IT companies. We design our digital marketing course according to the latest syllabus of digital marketing. We at Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing not only provide theoretical classes but also provide the opportunity for you to work on our client's live projects.

features.title: 100% Practical Live Projects
features.description: Hands-on implementation on live client campaigns powered by our in-house agency, Online Strikers.

features.title: Hybrid & Flexible Learning Modes
features.description: Attend in-class sessions at our modern campuses across North India or join interactive live online batches (weekday & weekend slots).

features.title: Free Doubt Clearing & Backup Sessions
features.description: Missed a class or need concept clarification? Attend any upcoming batch or schedule dedicated doubt sessions at zero extra cost.

features.title: Onboard Mentorship & Paid Internships
features.description: Work inside agency environments under senior project managers with opportunity for paid internships and News24 media collaboration.

features.title: Freelancer Push-Up Module
features.description: Dedicated training module designed to help students acquire international and domestic freelance clients and earn while learning.

features.title: 30+ Globally Recognized Certifications
features.description: Earn recognized credentials from Google, Meta, HubSpot, SEMrush, and the prestigious DIDM industry diploma.

student_resources.title: E-Resources & Learning Management System (LMS)
student_resources.description: DIDM provides comprehensive study materials, soft copies, free e-books, and curated software tools. Online and hybrid trainees enjoy 24/7 video access to class recordings through our proprietary LMS.
